title: Dokk Strassi
description: Dokk Strassi was an intimidating crime boss operating in one of the districts of Mos Espa as Boba Fett worked to regain control of Jabba the Hutt's territories in the wake of the crime lord's death. The Trandoshan criminal managed to make even the most respectful overtures sound threatening with his hissing manner of speech.
